title: Part
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch, which will serve as the first face. This sketch consists of a loop with four arcs and four lines. The first arc starts at the point (0.0, 0.0017), has a midpoint at (0.0005, 0.0005), and ends at (0.0017, 0.0). The first line extends from (0.0017, 0.0) to (0.0184, 0.0). The second arc starts at (0.0184, 0.0), has a midpoint at (0.0196, 0.0005), and ends at (0.0201, 0.0017). The second line goes from (0.0201, 0.0017) to (0.0201, 0.0184). The third arc begins at (0.0201, 0.0184), has a midpoint at (0.0196, 0.0196), and ends at (0.0184, 0.0201). The third line runs from (0.0184, 0.0201) to (0.0017, 0.0201). The fourth arc starts at (0.0017, 0.0201), has a midpoint at (0.0005, 0.0196), and ends at (0.0, 0.0184). The fourth line completes the loop, running from (0.0, 0.0184) back to (0.0, 0.0017). 

Next, draw the second two-dimensional sketch, which will serve as the second face. This sketch also consists of a loop with four arcs and four lines. The first arc starts at (0.0201, 0.0017), has a midpoint at (0.0206, 0.0005), and ends at (0.0218, 0.0). The first line extends from (0.0218, 0.0) to (0.0385, 0.0). The second arc starts at (0.0385, 0.0), has a midpoint at (0.0397, 0.0005), and ends at (0.0402, 0.0017). The second line goes from (0.0402, 0.0017) to (0.0402, 0.0184). The third arc begins at (0.0402, 0.0184), has a midpoint at (0.0397, 0.0196), and ends at (0.0385, 0.0201). The third line runs from (0.0385, 0.0201) to (0.0218, 0.0201). The fourth arc starts at (0.0218, 0.0201), has a midpoint at (0.0206, 0.0196), and ends at (0.0201, 0.0184). The fourth line completes the loop, running from (0.0201, 0.0184) back to (0.0201, 0.0017).

Scale the entire second sketch by a factor of 0.0402. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it using Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it using a vector also set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create the cylindrical object. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate the current part by creating a new solid body using the extruded sketch. The dimensions of the final part are a length of 0.04017857142857143 units, a width of 0.020089285714285716 units, and a height of 0.7500000000000001 units.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch for the base face
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Define the arcs and lines for the base face
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0017).threePointArc((0.0005, 0.0005), (0.0017, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0184, 0.0)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0196, 0.0005), (0.0201, 0.0017))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0201, 0.0184)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0196, 0.0196), (0.0184, 0.0201))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0017, 0.0201)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0005, 0.0196), (0.0, 0.0184))
sketch = sketch.close()

# Define the sketch for the top face
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0201, 0.0017).threePointArc((0.0206, 0.0005), (0.0218, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0385, 0.0)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0397, 0.0005), (0.0402, 0.0017))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0402, 0.0184)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0397, 0.0196), (0.0385, 0.0201))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0218, 0.0201)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0206, 0.0196), (0.0201, 0.0184))
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the H-shaped cross-section (top face)

     .lineTo(0.0100, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0100, 0.0067) \
     .lineTo(0.0302, 0.0067) \
     .lineTo(0.0302, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0402, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0402, 0.0201) \
     .lineTo(0.0302, 0.0201) \
     .lineTo(0.0302, 0.0134) \
     .lineTo(0.0100, 0.0134) \
     .lineTo(0.0100, 0.0201) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0201) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the beam
r = r.extrude(0.75)
